crystallized-agony.descripcion: A violet crystal containing the body of a dead creature, grown from its dying agony, pulses as it exudes motes of flickering energy.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) or Survival DC 35 (master) to know where to Strike a specific crystal perfectly on a facet to cause it to shatter harmlessly
datos.reinicio: A crystallized agony resets automatically and can be triggered again the next round.

doldrums-bud-pile.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-17: The Devil in the Details
doldrums-bud-pile.descripcion: Doldrum heaps that have only started to grow have no intelligence, but are incredibly tenacious and can reflexively grab onto nearby prey. They obtain nutrients by drowning prey in the water they grow in.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 35 (expert) to rip the reflexive tendrils off the bud or Thievery DC 35 (expert) to trigger the tendrils beforehand and keep them occupied.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour if the bud pile has something in its grasps. 1 round if the bud pile has nothing in its grasps.

ghost-mold.descripcion: A patch of black mold releases spoors when living creatures approach.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 29 (expert) to remove the mold safely
datos.reinicio: Unless entirely eradicated (typically with acid or fire), the mold regrows over the course of 2 weeks.

haunted-knife-collection.descripcion: Crates of knives and daggers shine with ill intent.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 26 (master) to exorcise the spirits, Crafting DC 33 (expert) to damage the knives, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 29) to counteract the crate
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The knife collection identifies targets. It first moves to have as many living creatures in its space as possible within a single Fly action, then attempts dagger Strikes against living creatures in its space.
datos.reinicio: The spirits in the hazard reactivate after 10 minutes.

ileosa-s-fifth-manifestation.descripcion: Mist coils from the ground, perhaps through a sewer grate or from cracks along a basement foundation, quickly forming into the ghostly image of Queen Ileosa.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 33 (expert) to exorcise the manifestation, or Intimidation DC 36 (trained) to stand one's ground without showing fear.

illusory-safeguard.descripcion: A phantasmal version of Itelybis appears to strike down a thief.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 30 or Thievery DC 30 (master) to disable the runes or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 30) to counteract them

lichen-monstrosity.descripcion: A mass of petrified lichen takes the shape of a beast and lurches forward.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 33 or Thievery DC 33 (master) to scrape away lichen without being exposed, or Medicine DC 36 or Nature DC 36 (expert) to concoct a natural remedy and weaken the hazard; four total successes are required to disable it.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) The lichen monstrosity uses 3 actions to move, traveling up to 30 feet with each action and dealing 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage. Each creature in its path must attempt a Reflex DC 31 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes half damage.
Failure The creature takes full damage and is exposed to leechlichen.
Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is exposed to leechlichen. The results of its saving throw against the leechlichen are treated as one step worse. Each successful check to disable this hazard reduces its movement by 30 feet, and the fourth success disables it completely.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets over the course of an hour.

lifeleech-crystal-patches.fuente: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City
lifeleech-crystal-patches.descripcion: Sharp, bloodthirsty crystals make walking through this chamber treacherous.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 30 (expert) to utter prayers that quell the crystals' necromantic compulsion to drink blood

lightning-s-dance.descripcion: Electricity suffuses an area where Agyra has used her lightning breath multiple times.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 35 (master) to fashion a makeshift lightning rod, Nature DC 33 (expert) to dissipate the electrical charge harmlessly into the air.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) Bolts of lightning flash out. The hazard makes two lightning bolt Strikes at two different creatures within 120 feet of the hazard's center. If only one creature is in range, the hazard makes only one Strike.
datos.reinicio: The hazard deactivates and immediately resets if has no targets for 1 round; it also resets if Agyra uses her lightning breath multiple times in a single combat in the area.

needling-stairs.descripcion: This staircase has springs in each step, which send poisoned needles shooting up through tiny holes in the wood when stepped on. Each step, 6 in total, takes up one 5-foot square.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) on each stair to disable its spring, or deactivate the switch in area C8 to deactivate the whole trap. Cutting the wire on the topmost stair () that connects the staircase to the control switch prevents the control switch from turning the trap on or off.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap makes a separate poisoned needle Strike against each creature currently on an active step as 1 action. Because it is constantly jabbing needles up through any weight-bearing steps, the trap can also use its Bloody Feet free action to jab at a creature on one of the steps during that creature's turn.
datos.reinicio: If deactivated via the switch, the trap can be reactivated with the switch in area C8.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 27 to beat out the flames, Crafting DC 27 to rig up a firefighting device, or Nature DC 27 to cut off avenues of the fire's spread. On a success, one square of the fire is extinguished (two squares on a critical success). Dousing a square in water, such as with create water, automatically extinguishes that square. When all squares are extinguished, the hazard ends.
datos.rutina: (1+ actions) Each square of flames spreads to an adjacent square, taking one action per square. Creatures adjacent to the fire take 3d6 fire damage each round from the heat (basic Fortitude DC 30 save); a creature who fails their save is Sickened 1 by the smoke (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). If there are more than 10 active squares of flames, creatures adjacent to the fire instead take 6d6 fire damage each round (basic Fortitude DC 30 save), and a creature who fails their save is sickened 2 (Sickened 3 on a critical failure). A creature standing in the flames takes 12d6 fire damage each round (basic Reflex DC 30 save); a creature who fails their save also takes 4d6 persistent damage.

nosois-vengeance.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
nosois-vengeance.descripcion: The sparrow on the scroll animates, speaking to the PCs in Noguchi's voice (one of the nosois from Event 11: Nosois' Brunch): "They're the ones! They're the blasphemers who can't even properly serve tea! Send them along to the Lady!"

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 36 (to quickly destroy the scroll without triggering the hazard), Religion DC 33 (to apologize to Pharasma and the nosois for the previous insult), or Dispel Magic (6th level; counteract DC 29).

promise-of-plagues.descripcion: Clouds of buzzing flies and a carpet of vermin fill a room strewn with decaying pieces of cast-off body parts and gobbets of rancid meat.

datos.desactivar: Three Arcana DC 33 or Nature DC 33 checks to command the vermin to be silent or to cleanse away the filth and decay to make the hazard harmless, a Religion DC 36 check to offer prayers to sever the sacred link to Kabriri, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 29) to render the hazard inert for 10 minutes
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The clouds of vermin in the room fill the air, rain down from the walls and ceiling, and swarm up from the floor below. All creatures in the room are subjected to Swarming Bites on the hazard's first action. On the second action, the swarming vermin grow particularly dense and eager in their attentions to one randomly determined creature in area J3c. If that creature is suffering from ghast fever and is at stage 4 or lower, they must immediately attempt a Fortitude DC 30 save. On a failure, the stage of their ghast fever advances one step.
datos.reinicio: The hazard settles back down 1 round after all creatures leave the room and can trigger again at the start of the next round.

raving-spirit.descripcion: The restless spirit of Currew raves against his tormentors when someone enters his room.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 30 (expert) to quiet the spirit for 1 round, or Religion DC 32 (master) to exorcise it
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The haunts casts Phantasmal Killer (Will DC 30 save and Fortitude DC 30 save for critical failure) on a random creature who can see Currew's bed (it can even target creatures outside of area B3, so long as the target can see the bed). Everyone affected by the phantasmal killer sees the same image: a sickly old man lies in the bed, screaming and ranting about his guilt, shame, and eventual death.
datos.reinicio: The haunt grows quiet and resets 1 minute after no creatures are in area B3.

serpent-s-gaze.descripcion: The circle opens to reveal a slitted serpent's eye, which begins to spin in hypnotizing fashion.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 29 (expert) to carefully cover the eye without triggering the hazard, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 29) to counteract the magic
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when the door is opened and closed.

shadows-of-everglut.descripcion: Swirling shadows that behave like animated pools of ink splash and slither up against the limbs of those who tread too far into this chamber.

datos.desactivar: Three Arcana DC 33 or Occultism DC 33 checks to redirect the negative energy back in on itself and disrupt the hazard's source of power, a Religion DC 36 check to offer prayers to sever the sacred link to Kabriri, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 29) to render the hazard inert for 10 minutes
datos.rutina: (1 action) The shadows writhing on the floor extrude a storm of inky tentacles of smoke and darkness that whip and writhe throughout the room, filling the air with unsettling sounds of agonizing cries and shrieks. All creatures in area J3a take 8d6 void damage (basic Fortitude DC 30 save).
datos.reinicio: The hazard settles back down 1 round after all creatures leave the room and can trigger again at the start of the next round.

shelyn-s-shame.descripcion: The statue begins to weep, its tears running in rivulets down into the surrounding pool, filling all nearby with overwhelming shame and grief.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 29 (master) to offer prayers to Shelyn (a worshipper of Shelyn gains a +2 circumstance bonus to this check), or Diplomacy DC 33 (expert) to offer condolences and comforts to the haunt

spider-summoning-rune.descripcion: An Invisible rune on the floor summons a Goliath Spider when disturbed by someone who isn't wearing Norgorber's religious symbol.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (master) to erase the rune or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 36) to dispel the rune.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

springloaded-statues-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court
springloaded-statues-9-10.descripcion: Four animal statues sit on pillars, one in each corner of the statuary, with decorated tiles between them in a seemingly random arrangement.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (expert) or Stealth DC 32 (expert) to disarm the statue while adjacent to it
datos.reinicio: Each statue resets immediately after being triggered.

stinger-ward-trap.descripcion: A ghostly stinger appears in the air and jabs at anyone moving through the opening.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 36 (master) to prevent the ghostly stinger from forming or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 34).
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

storm-tossed-sea.descripcion: A relentless storm assails the ship, battering those on board who don't secure themselves.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 29, Crafting, or Sailing Lore to securely lash one's self to the ship. Creatures tied to the ship are immune to the hazard's routine but are Immobilized.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The storm tosses the ship in a random direction (roll 1d8 to determine). All creatures on the ship that aren't lashed to it are moved 10 feet in that direction and must attempt a Reflex DC 30 save or Sailing Lore check as the waves pummel them.

—
Critical Success The creature takes no damage and can avoid being moved 10 feet if it wishes.
Success The creature takes no damage.
Failure The creature is Off-Guard and takes 1d12+15 bludgeoning damage.
Critical Failure The creature is Prone and takes 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage.

tar-baphon-s-shadow.descripcion: A manifestation of Tar-Baphon drains the essence of its divine target.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 33 (expert) to disrupt Tar-Baphon's magic, Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 (master) to suppress the shadow's energy; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt unless the Carcass Man is destroyed, in which case it's automatically destroyed
datos.rutina: (1 action; death) The haunt drains Zagresh's divine energies, dealing 5d10 void damage.

the-babies-are-so-hungry.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
the-babies-are-so-hungry.descripcion: The dreamwell plant shudders and pulses, emitting more potent odors before it bursts into swarms of ravenous ghostly spiders.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 33 (master) to use the dreamwell plant's own blooms to soothe the ghostly spiders or Religion DC 36 (trained) to exorcise the ghostly spiders; three successes are required to disable the haunt completely
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) An immense swarm of thumb-sized spiders boil out of the plant's planter box and its bulbous trunk, filling the air with the nauseating sound of tens of thousands of tiny clawed feet scuttling everywhere. The haunt uses its first action to spray webbing through the area so that every creature in the room must succeed at a Reflex DC 30 save to avoid taking a –5-foot status penalty to their Speed. These penalties stack with multiple failed Reflex saves, and a character whose penalties reduce their Speed to 0 becomes Immobilized ().
On its second action, the phantasmal spiders begin to bite and gnaw at living flesh with fangs that are suddenly both very real and very toxic. Every creature in the room takes 2d10 piercing and 2d10 poison damage (basic Fortitude DC 30 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the end of any round in which there are no Small or larger living creatures in the room, then resets automatically.

trapped-portcullis.descripcion: Two portcullises drop down to block progress through this area.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) to disable the trigger that causes the portcullises to drop
datos.reinicio: The trap can be manually reset with a 10-minute Manipulate activity performed in the hallways to the east or west of this area, as long as neither portcullis is broken or destroyed.

tusk-mountains-avalanche.descripcion: Snow and ice gathered at the peaks of the mountain come crashing down in an explosive wave.

datos.desactivar: Three Crafting DC 34 or Engineering-lore DC 34 (expert) to create cover for a 10-foot square area and shelter from the avalanche; a flying creature can attempt a Acrobatics DC 29 check to Maneuver in Flight to avoid the avalanche

vaultquake.descripcion: The retreating vaultline causes a series of cave-ins.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 31, Nature DC 31, Occultism DC 31, or Religion DC 31 (master) to disperse the ley line's power as it retreats, or Survival DC 27 (expert) to predict where rubble might fall next. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the cavern, ending the hazard.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The GM rolls a Flat DC 9 to determine if a cave-in occurs. On a successful check, falling rubble deals 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage to a random PC (basic Reflex DC 30 save). On a critical success, the collapse deals 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage to all the PCs instead.
datos.reinicio: After 4 rounds, the hazard ends automatically as the vaultquake subsides.

warding-bell.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
warding-bell.descripcion: At the heart of the shrine hangs a massive bronze temple bell.

datos.desactivar: Ringing the bell as an Interact action eight times in succession with the ceremonial ringer (carried by Mago Kai) over the course of three consecutive rounds automatically deactivates the hazard, Religion DC 36 to appeal to Pharasma to extinguish the flame, Thievery DC 36 to extinguish the flame within the bell, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 29) or a shimmerthief's Drain Light ability to disable the wards
datos.rutina:
(1 action; divine, emotion, enchantment, fear, mental) The warding bell emits a harrowing ring that can be heard only by undead or transmigrated PCs in area C11; affected characters must attempt a Will DC 30 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to the warding bell's routine for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 1 and takes 6d6 mental damage.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2, takes 12d6 mental damage, and is Fleeing as long as it remains frightened.
datos.reinicio: Reactivating the warding bell requires a complicated rite taking several days.

weakened-floor--pathfinder-season-of-gho.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
weakened-floor--pathfinder-season-of-gho.descripcion: The weakened floor gives way with a tremendous crash, dropping everything in the room into a muddy morass of toxic mold.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 33 (master) three times to knock holes in the floor without triggering the spore cloud while simultaneously lightening the strain on the floor so it can be walked upon, Stealth DC 36 (expert) to move carefully through the room for the remainder of your turn without triggering the hazard, or Nature DC 36 (expert) twice once the trap is triggered to knock enough holes into the nearby walls to cause the spores to disperse
datos.rutina: (1 action) Every round on its turn, the spores that now fill area A4 inflict 8d6 poison damage to all creatures in the room (basic Fortitude DC 30 save) as the cloud burns at exposed flesh; a creature that holds its breath gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this saving throw.
datos.reinicio: One minute after nothing moves in the room, the spores settle down. The floor remains obvious and won't collapse further, but any creature that moves through the mold causes the spores to plume up again, re-triggering the trap.

alchemical-cloud.descripcion: The collection of bottles at the bottom of one locker have been jostled. Their contents leak into a puddle, and their vapors burn through the open air.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 30 (master) to neutralize the alchemical substances, or Thievery DC 35 (expert) to carefully clean the spill
datos.reinicio: If the reagents aren't cleaned up before closing the locker, the accumulating gases reset the trap after 1 hour.

azure-lilies.descripcion: The azure lilies expel a burst of toxic pollen.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 33 or Survival DC 33 (expert) to harvest the plant's pollen without disturbing the blossoms.
datos.reinicio: 1 month

bloating-fleshwarp.descripcion: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes creatures to swell with blood.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30 (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets after 1 minute.

boneburst-fleshwarp.descripcion: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes bone spurs to rip through flesh.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30 (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

broken-rebus-attack.descripcion: Ghostly attackers knock the tables about, send dishes flying, and pull fleeing creatures into the room.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 34 (expert) to say an Iroran prayer and put the haunt temporarily to rest, Occultism DC 38 (master) to create a ward against future hauntings.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt sends a flurry of objects hurtling across the room. All creatures in the room are battered by the ghostly objects, taking 3d10+14 force damage (basic Reflex DC 36 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates after 1 minute. It re-forms at the same times every day, 7 a.m. and 7 p.m., which is when the monks had their morning and evening meals. If at least two people cook a meal in the kitchen, share a meal in the refectory, and utter a prayer to Irori before the meal, the haunt becomes permanently disabled and doesn't re-form.

call-of-the-void.descripcion: A supernatural compulsion to leap into the unknown exerts itself on anyone who approaches the ledge.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 34 or Arcana DC 36 to expel the magical compulsion from the current island and from any of the red ropes directly attached to it, darkening the rope in color. The Echo also automatically disables the hazard from any island he's standing on, and any of the red ropes directly attached to it, when he Reconstitutes from Thought on that island.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The call targets all creatures adjacent to a ledge or on one of the red ropes and tugs at their minds. A creature who has already fallen this round is immune.
datos.reinicio: The call of the void persists as long as the Echo exists, though it doesn't activate until the Echo has rolled initiative. The hazard resets each day.

dahak-s-shell.descripcion: A ring of eight dragon pillar replicas mark the border of a dome of magical prismatic energy that entirely contains the Fortress of Sorrow.

datos.desactivar: Each dragon pillar that is destroyed removes the corresponding color's effect from Dahak's shell; as long as even one color remains active, the pillars marking the shell's border cannot be damaged themselves, but a successful Thievery DC 32 (master) check or a successful Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 30) against one of the eight pillars can cause a randomly determined active color in the shell defense (below) to become deactivated for {1d4 rounds}.

desperate-hunger.descripcion: A skeletally thin spirit appears, weeping as it shoves earth and stones down its throat in an effort to stave off hunger.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 36 (master) to convince the spirit it's no longer hungry or Occultism DC 38 (trained) to ritually feed the spirit
datos.reinicio: 1 day

diabolic-vigor.descripcion: Tendrils of infernal energy reach out from the Inferno Gate like tentacles, infusing the creatures that serve it, even tangentially, with vitality and protection from harm.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 30 (expert) to pray for divine intervention in counterbalancing this infernal influence; Arcana DC 35 (expert), Nature DC 35 (expert), or Occultism DC 35 (expert) to exert a magical force of will greater than the gate's influence; Athletics DC 38 (expert) or Thievery (expert) to disrupt the pentagram surrounding the Inferno Gate; or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 30) to cut off the magical energies. Magical checks to disable this hazard can be attempted from up to 30 feet away from the Inferno Gate, but physical checks require physically touching the pentagram; three successes are required to disrupt the diabolic vigor hazard.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its turn, the diabolic vigor hazard empowers the merztorlegon and their bound armies within 200 feet of the Inferno Gate. It grants the siege devil regeneration 20 and reduces their weakness to holy from 20 to 10. The armies gain regeneration 10 and reduce their weakness to area damage and splash damage by 5. These effects last for 1 round.

dream-poisoned-door.descripcion: Eerie shapes manifest within the doorway as it's opened, conjuring a group of four Animate Dreams into being.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 30 (expert) to concentrate on the eldritch energies and diffuse them through meditation, Thievery DC 35 (master) to scratch warding runes along the door's hinges and block dreams from manifesting, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 30) to counteract the trap

earthquake.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-19: What Walks Again
earthquake.descripcion: The earth shakes violently side to side, opening a fissure in the ground, partially collapsing builds, and scattering debris in all directions.

explosive-furniture-trap.descripcion: Wiring keeping the furniture together unravels, causing the spring-loaded pieces of furniture and wire to shoot outward.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (expert) to identify and harmlessly cut the taut wiring

false-door-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven
false-door-trap.descripcion: A hidden needle delivers a magical poison to anyone trying to open the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (master) to jam the needle in its housing or Dispel Magic (6th rank, counteract DC 30) to dispel the magical poison.

feedback-flow.descripcion: The fetid material in this pit sloshes around in a disgusting feedback loop, filled with large pieces of solid trash that risk bludgeoning creatures inside it to death!

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 27 or Thievery DC 27 (trained) to move without causing a wave of filth, or Athletics DC 30 or Crafting DC 30 (trained) to stabilize the trash heap and prevent it from flowing; three successes are required to fully stabilize and disable the hazard.
datos.rutina:
(1 to 3 actions) The feedback flow hazard uses up to 3 actions to make flowing trash Strikes against living creatures that take move actions inside the refuse pit (area E7) but can only target an individual creature once per round. The ofalths, used to living in this pit, don't trigger these attacks. Additionally, any non-ofalth creature that ends its turn inside the refuse pit must attempt a Fortitude DC 36 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is Sickened 1 until the end of its next turn, then is immune to this effect for 1 minute.
Failure The creature is sickened 1.
Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 2.

flensing-chute.fuente: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star
flensing-chute.descripcion: The stairs collapse into a downward spiral.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 35 (master) to decouple several mechanisms barely accessible through gaps between the shifting risers, or Perception DC 38 to note which stairs have slightly different wear patterns to know which ones are safe to step on
datos.reinicio: The flensing chute resets automatically.

fleshwarp-fetters.descripcion: A surge of fleshwarping magic twists creatures' limbs, especially those used to move.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30 (trained) or Occultism DC 30 (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets after 1 minute.

flinching-fleshwarp.descripcion: A surge of fleshwarping magic sets nerves on fire.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30 (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping.
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets after 1 minute.

floor-be-gone.descripcion: Hinged boards prop the massive paving stones into place on the causeway.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 27 (expert) to reinforce the stones of this causeway or Thievery DC 29 (master) to jam the hinges on the boards

images-of-failure.descripcion: Psychically enhanced illusions flood the minds of creatures in the 40-foot-long, 15-foot-wide hallway (the white dotted box on the map) with memories of their past failures.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 32 (master) or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to weaken the images; three successes are required to disable the trap
datos.reinicio: The trap resets immediately and can affect the same creature multiple times on the creature's turn.

images-of-powerlessness.descripcion: Psychically-enhanced illusions flood the minds of creatures in the 95-foot-long, 15-foot-wide hallway (the white dotted box on the map) with visions of their failures yet to come.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 32 (master) or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to weaken the images; three successes are required to disable the trap
datos.reinicio: The trap resets immediately and can affect the same creature multiple times on the creature's turn.

locus-of-death.descripcion: A magical orb inflicts terrible visions of gruesome ends on anyone who approaches.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 27 (master) to infuse the locus with life force, Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 (expert) to counteract the locus's energies, Thievery DC 35 (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
datos.rutina: (1 action; death, emotion, fear, mental) One living creature in the haunt's location (determined randomly) is targeted by a 4th-rank Vision of Death (Will DC 32). A creature that critically fails their save doesn't physically flee but instead can't attempt to disable the hazard until they're no longer frightened. Once all creatures have been affected, the haunt deactivates.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.

locus-of-destruction.descripcion: A magical orb drives intruders to commit acts of mindless destruction.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 27 (master) to reconfigure the locus, Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 (expert) to counteract the locus's energies, Thievery DC 35 (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
datos.rutina:
(1 action; mental) The destructive impulses grow stronger. Affected creatures must attempt a Will DC 32 save; creatures who fail or critically fail can't attempt to disable the haunt that turn.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.
Success The creature is unaffected this round.
Failure The creature becomes Confused for 1 round, targeting both creatures and objects.
Critical Failure As failure but the confusion lasts for 1 minute.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.

locus-of-pain.descripcion: An arcane orb sits upon a sinister altar, filling creatures in the area with unimaginable pain.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 27 (master) to soothe the locus's pain, Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 to counteract the locus's energies, Thievery DC 35 (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
datos.rutina: (1 action; mental, nonlethal) Creatures affected by the haunt's agony lash are wracked with pain, as 4th-rank Phantom Pain (Will DC 32). If a creature falls Unconscious due to the haunt, they don't continue taking damage.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.

malfunctioning-engine.descripcion: The malfunctioning ecdysis engine warps the flesh of creatures that enter the room.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 32 (expert) or Occultism DC 32 (expert) four times to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 30) to cleanse the vaultline's effect on the ecdysis engine. Closing the sluice in area B1 drains power from the engine and counts as one success, as does calibrating the control panel in area B23. For each success, reduce the hazard's number of actions by 1.
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) The warpline focuses on a random creature in the room, which must make a Fortitude DC 36 save. A single creature can't be targeted more than once on the hazard's turn.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and gains a +1 status bonus to further saves vs. the hazard.
Success The creature is unaffected.
Failure The creature becomes Enfeebled 1 or Clumsy 1 (determined randomly), or its enfeebled or clumsy condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of 4 for each condition).
Critical Failure As failure, except the condition value becomes 2 or increases by 2.

pain-milker.descripcion: An eerie machine made of levers, crystals, and glowing bits of metal that, as one draws near, causes unsettling aches and pains.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) to deactivate the machine, or Perception DC 38 (expert) to decipher the proper order in which the switches and dials should be adjusted in order to power the device down harmlessly
datos.reinicio: If the augnagar still lives and at least one crystallized agony is still functional, the pain milker resets automatically in a number of rounds equal to 7 - the number of remaining crystallized agonies.

red-tinged-doorway.descripcion: A swirling portal leads to unwholesome places.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 35, Occultism DC 35, or Thievery DC 35 (master); must have studied Carlina's notes

slithering-snakes.descripcion: A black, snake-shaped rune summons sinuous, shadowy serpents to grab and bite intruders throughout the room.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 31 (expert) to approach the desk without triggering the trap, followed by Thievery DC 33 (expert) to erase the rune; conversely, Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rune

stage-fire.descripcion: Flames engulf the opera house's stage.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 27 to extinguish two adjacent squares of fire (with a critical success extinguishing four adjacent squares); any water spell (such as from Create Water or Hydraulic Push) cast at the fire extinguishes two squares automatically, or 2d4 adjacent squares if the caster of the spell achieves a DC 30 result with a spell attack roll; Quench instantly extinguishes all fire within its 20‑foot burst.
datos.rutina:
On its turn, the stage fire expands inward and outward by 5 feet, filling all adjacent squares with fire. Creatures within these squares take 4d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 30), as do any creatures that enter a burning square. This fire damage can be inflicted on a creature only once per turn.

In addition, a creature that ends its turn in a burning square takes 8d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 30); on a failed save, that creature also takes 1d6 persistent damage.

stygian-fires.descripcion: Freezing black fire bursts from the two quartz altars, filling the room with numbing black flames that scour away memories and emotions as swiftly as they sear flesh and bone.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (master) to sever the links between the door and the lanterns, Religion DC 35 (master) to use prayer to deactivate the divine magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 30) to counteract the trap
datos.reinicio: The trap resets one minute after the doors to area E3 are closed.

thalassophobia-pool.descripcion: The pool sucks in creatures that fall into it, making them sink into its endless depths.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 32 (master) to quell the fear and calm the pool or Intimidation DC 35 to give the pool something worse to fear; three successes required.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Water from the chalice increases the depth of the water by 10 feet for each action. Each time this happens, creatures in the pool are pushed 10 feet down and take 1d6 bludgeoning damage. As the pool has no bottom, creatures in it can fall down indefinitely; they must Swim up to avoid drowning, but the water is especially choppy, so the Athletics DC is Athletics DC 25. The pool never overflows. Each successful check to Disable reduces the pool's actions by 1, and once the pool is completely Disabled, the water becomes still and the Athletics DC to Swim becomes Athletics DC 10.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets once there are no moving creatures in it.

trump-of-the-oliphaunt.descripcion: An overwhelming trumpeting sound vibrates and suffuses the area, causing everything to slow.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 38 (expert), Maelstrom-lore DC 38 (expert), Occultism DC 38 (master), Religion DC 38 (master) to recognize and shore up the area against the localized planar instability causing a connection to the Oliphaunt of Jandelay. Four successes are needed to strengthen the area enough against the instability to end the hazard.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude DC 36 save. A creature with the slowed condition from this hazard takes a –2 circumstance penalty on further saves against this effect.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 2d6+6 sonic damage and is Deafened for 1 round.
Failure The creature takes 4d6+13 sonic damage and is Slowed 1 for 2 rounds.
Critical Failure The creature takes 8d6+26 sonic damage and is Slowed 2 for 2 rounds.
datos.reinicio: The area becomes unstable again after 24 hours.

twisted-king-s-court.descripcion: Countless fey with grisly visages and misshapen bodies cavort throughout the room, kicking up caustic debris and pulling other creatures into their dangerous dance.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 32 or Occultism DC 32 (expert) to perform a ritual to ward the area against fey intrusion, Performance DC 34 (master) to meet the Twisted King's demands with a disturbing dance, or Athletics DC 32 or Intimidation DC 32 (expert) to fend off or frighten the fey dancers. Three total successes are required to disable the haunt, and each check takes 2 actions.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Spectral fey cavort about the room. All creatures in the room are raked by ghostly claws and splashed with toxic water, taking 1d10+14 force,2d10 acid damage (basic Reflex DC 32 save). Creatures that critically fail their Reflex saves are pulled 10 feet toward the standing stones.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates after 1 minute. It re-forms every new moon. If all of the glyphs in area B6 are restored—a process requiring 10 days of downtime and 10 successful Nature DC 36 or Occultism DC 36 checks—the haunt becomes permanently disabled and doesn't re-form.

unraveling-fleshwarp.descripcion: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes a creature's flesh to unravel.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30 (trained) or Occultism DC 30 (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets after 1 minute.

withermold.fuente: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower
withermold.descripcion: Coils of pale yellow thorny fungal vines on which grow hundreds of brown puffballs suddenly whip into frenzied life.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 33 (master) twice to exorcise the unholy presence within the withermold, or Survival DC 35 (master) twice to safely remove the sensory tendrils growing in the mold
datos.rutina: (3 actions) A withermold makes three Strikes with its thorny vines on its turn, splitting its Strikes up among potential targets before striking a single target more than once.
datos.reinicio: A withermold deactivates at the end of any round when there are no targets within reach to attack with thorny vine Strikes. It resets immediately unless it's used all its Spore Burst reactions for the day, in which case the withermold resets in 24 hours.

wraithwell.descripcion: An orb of undeath draws creatures closer to a cursed existence.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 27 to negate the forces of undeath (master), Occultism DC 30 (expert) to channel vital energy, Thievery DC 35 (master) to extricate the orb from the altar
datos.rutina: (1 action; void) The wraiths attack all living creatures in the area, dealing 3d10+14 void damage (basic Fortitude DC 32 save). Creatures who fail their saves are Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical failure) or increase their drained value by 1 (2 on a critical failure), up to a maximum of Drained 4.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.

acidic-poison-cloud-trap.descripcion: Five nozzles hidden across the apartment's ceiling spew thick clouds of acidic poison from a reinforced tank behind the wall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 35 (expert) to block one of the nozzles or Thievery DC 40 (master) to shut off the tank. The trap deactivates after 5 rounds, once the tank is empty.
datos.rutina: (1 action) When it's triggered, the trap has five active nozzles, but at the end of its turn each round, one random nozzle deactivates. On the trap's turn, the active nozzles emit a cloud of acidic poison gas that expands to fill the apartment. The cloud deals 1d6 acid,1d6 poison damage per active nozzle to each creature and object in the room (basic Fortitude DC 33 save). Unattended objects automatically fail saves to avoid the damage.

arcane-feedback-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven
arcane-feedback-trap.descripcion: A spike of stone bursts from the south wall and quickly retracts.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 33 (master) to quell the rippling stone or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to dispel the magical feedback.

boiling-tub-trap.descripcion: A snapped trip wire causes an alchemical bomb to detonate and blow up part of the tin tub, spilling boiling water all over the trap's victim.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (master) to safely remove the trip wire from the bomb

bounding-hounds.descripcion: Three phantom hounds chase down intruders, damaging any they pass through.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 36 (expert) to calm each hound, or Occultism DC 38 (master) to banish each hound
datos.rutina: (9 actions) The trap loses 3 actions each round for each hound disabled. Each hound uses three actions to Stride 40 feet after creatures in the room, passing through corporeal creatures during this movement if possible. Each creature the hound moves through during its movement takes 2d8 + 7 void damage (Reflex DC 37 negates). A creature can only be damaged by each hound once each round, no matter how many times the hound moves through their space.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

brooding-fvalthahalia.descripcion: Tiny black flames mirror living creatures' movements in the city above as scraps of shadow patrol the streets-flames that notice intruders in their "sky" below and reach out to the intruders "above" with a deafening violence that incidentally alerts several of the vault's denizens to the intruders' presence.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 40 (master) to adjust the model so its attention is focused inward, Occultism DC 37 (expert) to cause the accumulated psychic energy to discharge harmlessly, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 32). A character who sneaks through the room with a Stealth DC 32 (expert) check avoids triggering the hazard, but this does not disable it.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

buzzing-latch-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune on the door begins emitting a very loud buzzing sound, potentially paralyzing an intruder.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (master) to disrupt the rune without triggering it or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 31) to magically counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

clockwork-looms.descripcion: The looms spring to life, sending skeins of spidersilk yarn between them that attempt to ensnare nearby creatures and pull them into the machinery.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 46 (master) to shut down all eight looms at once by activating either of the bypass locks once either lock is located (this check is automatically successful if Fenton's keys are used), Thievery DC 37 (master) twice to shut down a single loom by deftly removing critical components, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 33) to counteract a single loom
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Each loom takes one of two possible actions on its turn, depending on if it's currently restraining a creature or not.
Not Restraining a Creature: If a loom isn't restraining a creature, it launches a tangle of yarn at a random creature in the room that isn't currently Restrained. That creature must attempt a Reflex DC 37 save. If there are no non-restrained targets for the loom to attempt to grapple, it takes no actions this round.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is entangled, and becomes Clumsy 1 until the end of the looms' next turn.
Failure The creature is tangled in the yarn and becomes Clumsy 2 until the end of the loom's next turn—or if it already has the clumsy condition, it becomes restrained (see critical failure).
Critical Failure The creature becomes restrained. A restrained creature can Force Open the tangle of yarn or Escape with a DC 37 check.
Restraining a Creature: If a loom has restrained a creature, it instead fires more lines of yarn at the restrained creature and then drags that creature (if the creature is Medium or smaller) 20 feet toward itself. (If it's restraining a Large or larger creature, it can only drag the creature 5 feet toward itself). If this dragging causes a creature to become adjacent to the loom, the loom pulls the creature into its grinding gears and inflicts 5d12 bludgeoning,5d12 slashing damage to the creature (basic Reflex DC 37 save). The creature is then placed in an adjacent square and is still restrained by that loom.
datos.reinicio: A loom deactivates if no Small or larger creatures are in area C6, resetting in 1 minute unless disabled or all looms are broken.

glyph-of-warding-b8.descripcion: A magical glyph flashes before triggering a spell.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (trained) to disable the glyph, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 33) to counteract the glyph

glyph-of-warding-kingmaker.descripcion: An hourglass-shaped glyph flashes with mauve light, then seems to quickly drain its sand away, as if to indicate time has suddenly run out.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (trained) to remove the glyph without triggering it, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 34) to counteract the glyph.

ileosa-s-sixth-manifestation.descripcion: Ileosa manifests as a crimson ghost and reaches out as if to receive a gift from the ritual's primary caster.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 37 (expert) or Occultism DC 40 (trained) to reverse the ritual's power.

life-draining-thunder.descripcion: Thassilonian runes set with onyx erupt with negative energy and thunderous roars at the presence of a living creature.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 35 (master) to destroy the key rune, Arcana DC 37 (master) to harmlessly discharge the runes, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the trap

pain-coral.descripcion: Haunted coral transfers pain between creatures.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 33 or Occultism DC 37 or Thievery DC 37 to pinpoint and disable key synaptic nerves throughout the coral, Religion DC 37 to quell the coral's tortured memories; each success reduces the coral's number of actions per turn by 1, and the hazard is disabled when after four successes.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The coral casts Phantom Pain as a 6th-rank spell on a target (DC 33), targeting creatures that aren't already taking persistent mental damage.
datos.reinicio: The coral diffuses and resets after 1 minute.

rockfall.descripcion: Rubble from the damaged walls falls on creatures that move into the area.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 33 (expert) or Athletics DC 37 (expert) to shore up the crumbling walls

shattered-runewell-of-pride.fuente: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
shattered-runewell-of-pride.descripcion: Plumes of magenta and violet light and vapor shift and writhe out of a hole in reality surrounded by the fragments of a runewell suspended mid-explosion.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 37 (master) or Occultism DC 40 (master) to redirect the magic back in on itself and cancel out the danger, or Crafting DC 40 (legendary) to reposition runewell fragments so they're not dangerous; three total successes are required to disable the shattered runewell
datos.rutina: (3 actions) When the shattered runewell takes its first action, a towering, 30-foot-tall image of Runelord Xanderghul formed from scintillating magenta and violet light and fire looms up from the runewell. On each of the hazard's three actions, this manifestation of Runelord Xanderghul scowls down at the PCs, and tendrils of strangely colored fire lash out of the runewell, each targeting a different PC in the area. The effects of these tendrils vary according to their color; these ranged Strikes can target anyone in the Eye of Arrogance and accrue multiple attack penalties normally.

spiked-barricade-trap.descripcion: Spring-loaded wedges of sharpened stone pop out of the wooden barricade.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (expert) to suppress the spring mechanism for one 5-foot segment of the barricade
datos.reinicio: The trap must be manually reset by pushing the wedges back into place.

spore-stomach.fuente: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower
spore-stomach.descripcion: A puffball-like fungus periodically vents gray spores into the air.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 37 (master) three times to carefully prune away the fungal roots that connect to the garden below, or Religion DC 37 (master) three times to exorcise the demonic energies from the fungus
datos.rutina: (1 action; divine, poison) On the first round, the spore stomach sprays a 40-foot-long cone of spores into the left half of area E1. On the second round, it sprays spores into the right half of area E1. On the third round, it takes no action. It repeats this pattern thereafter every 3 rounds. A creature in the area of spores takes 10d6 poison damage (basic Fortitude DC 37 save).
datos.reinicio: The spore stomach deactivates if it starts a turn and there are no non-fungus creatures in area E1. It then immediately resets.

test-of-agility.descripcion: The floor of this circular room pivots and shifts awkwardly when weight is placed upon its surface, pitching those who attempt to walk on it off their feet and potentially into one of two deep spiked pits.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 37 (expert) to wedge scraps of material into the edges of the room to hamper the floor's tilt (requires 4 successes).
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative each turn, the floor tilts randomly, forcing all characters standing on the floor of the room to attempt a Reflex DC 33 save to avoid being pitched into one of the two pits.
datos.reinicio: This trap resets instantly.

test-of-endurance.descripcion: The room fills with swirling vortexes of freezing wind that swiftly freeze flesh and chill the bones.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) to adjust the wheel's mechanisms so that it won't trigger the Test of Endurance, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to counteract the trap's magic.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically.

test-of-strength.descripcion: The steps angle downward into a slope, releasing all currently placed boulders to roll back down to the north.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 37 (expert) to disable the hidden hinges for one of the steps, thereby locking all four steps into place
datos.reinicio: The trap Releases Boulders 24 hours after it Opens Doors. Once the trap Releases Boulders, it resets itself automatically.

test-of-tactics.descripcion: Obscure magical runes hidden within the runes of the 16 named warriors bind a pair of derghodaemons into the walls of this hallway.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 37 (expert) to remove a set of runes linked to one bound derghodaemon, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to counteract the trap's magic.
datos.reinicio: If at least one of the Derghodaemons survives, the trap resets after 1 hour, causing the surviving derghodaemons to be completely restored to full health and to merge with the floors.

unfinished-portalrender.descripcion: A sphere of concentrated agony harvested from a qlippoth begins pulsing with violet light as it blasts the room with otherworldly agony.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 37 (master) to dismantle the housing and refocus the agony inward so it consumes itself harmlessly, Arcana DC 33 or Occultism DC 33 (master) to vent the agony in a controlled way that causes the portalrender to become inert after 1 minute (during which it can still be triggered normally), or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31)
datos.rutina: The unfinished portalrender continues to flood area B4 with agony, and everyone in the room must attempt a Will DC 33 save against its Agonizing Pulse. At the end of its turn, the unfinished portalrender attempts a Flat DC 6. On a failure, its stores of agony deplete and it deactivates, causing the central orb of agony to fade away permanently.

wailing-crystals.fuente: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City
wailing-crystals.descripcion: Three clusters of gleaming, colorful crystals are corrupted with necromantic energy that causes them to reflect negative emotions. All three must be disabled or destroyed to negate the hazard.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 29 (master) to carefully fracture the crystals or Crafting DC 27 (expert) to place objects to stop the resonance, both disabling one 5-foot patch of crystals.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The hazard uses each action for an Anguished Shriek. The wailing crystals lose 1 action for each 5-foot patch of crystals that is broken or destroyed.
datos.reinicio: The wailing crystals deactivate and reset once no living creatures are within 20 feet.

witherweird-runes.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
witherweird-runes.descripcion: Magic stored in runes painted in powdered bone and banshees' tears lash out at anyone other than Heh Shan-Bao who opens the secondary compartment.

datos.desactivar: to scratch out the runes and dissipate their magic harmlessly, Arcana DC 40 to sabotage the spell and cause the runes to dry up and blow away as inert powder, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the runes

wronged-monk-s-wrath.descripcion: A monk's tormented spirit attacks intruders.

datos.desactivar: Irori Lore (trained) to clean the room and return the prayer items to their proper arrangement, Religion DC 37 (expert) to state an Iroran prayer of peace and put the haunt to rest, or Occultism DC 40 (master) to create a ward against future hauntings
datos.reinicio: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature lights all of the candles in the room and offers a prayer to Irori.

air-rift.descripcion: A portal to the Plane of Air rips open onstage, causing roaring winds to tear through the opera house

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 38 (master) to sew the magical threads of the rift shut, Nature DC 40 or Survival DC 40 (legendary) to open enough windows and doors to reduce its intensity, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 34) to counteract the air rift
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Winds blow through the area in a random direction, causing creatures and objects within 50 feet of the air rift to float up, down, north, south, east, or west (roll a d6 to determine which direction). Creatures and objects in the area must attempt a Fortitude DC 37 save. If a creature is pushed into a solid object or another creature by this effect, both take 3d8+15 bludgeoning damage on impact.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 10 feet, but takes only half damage from impact.

Failure The creature is pushed 20 feet, falls prone, and takes full damage from impact.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 40 feet, falls prone, and takes double damage from impact.

archway-barrier.descripcion: A shimmering field of force fills the carved wooden archway, beyond which a flight of stairs leads upward.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 30 (expert) to perform the four aria lines (requires four successes), Thievery DC 41 (master) to deface one of the four carved images (requires four successes), disintegrate of any rank, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to counteract the barrier
datos.reinicio: The harmonic barrier resets the instant after it is triggered.

boneburst.descripcion: A low howl rises from the ground, gathering strength as scraps of ancient armor, bone fragments, and clumps of earth rise into the air. Crimson vapor holds the faceless shape together, never coalescing into an identifiable form, but merely writhing through ever-changing images of torment and destruction.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 38 (master) to temporarily negate the psychic resonances around each fragment, causing the agglomeration to fall apart, or Religion DC 33 (expert) to temporarily interrupt Verex-That-Was's unholy power with divine energy from another source. If a boneburst takes 40 points of damage from a single source and it isn't destroyed, it is rendered dormant for 1 round.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) An awakened boneburst occupies a 20-foot square; it is reduced to a 10-foot square when it reaches its BT. It can occupy the same space as other creatures, but not other bonebursts. On its initiative, the boneburst Flies up to 30 feet toward the nearest living creature as its first action. As its second action, the boneburst then coalesces around any living creature within its space, invisible shards of bone tearing at their flesh. Each living creature in its space takes 2d10+18 slashing damage and 1d10 spirit damage (basic Reflex DC 35 save). If no living creatures are within its space, the boneburst can use its second action to Fly up to 30 feet.
datos.reinicio: If the boneburst spends 5 consecutive rounds without coalescing around a living creature, it falls dormant, sinking back into the earth. After it falls dormant or is disabled, the boneburst gathers energy over the course of the next hour, after which it can be triggered again.

cutthroat-haunt.descripcion: The pain and agony endured by Abbot Ildeben as the Gardener cut his throat lingers on in this room.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 38 check to appeal to the haunt and convince it the PCs aren't the source of its pain, or Religion DC 33 to rebuke the haunt in Cayden Cailean's name.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

darkside-mirror.descripcion: A magic mirror replaces characters with malicious mirror duplicates from another dimension.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (legendary) to retrieve a creature from the other dimension within 10 minutes of the switch (possible only if their mirror duplicate is dead), Thievery DC 39 (master) to permanently disable the mirror once all mirror duplicates are dead, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 32) to counteract the mirror for 1 minute and prevent additional replacements during that time.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The mirror absorbs another reflected creature and replaces it with a mirror duplicate. A mirror duplicate attacks on their own initiative, using the same statistics as the original creature, but they hate all other non-duplicate creatures. A mirror duplicate can spend 3 actions in contact with the mirror to return to their original dimension and release the duplicated creature.
datos.reinicio: The mirror is always ready to absorb creatures into the other dimension. Ten minutes after a creature is sucked into the mirror, if an ally doesn't rescue the creature, it reaches the other dimension. In the mirror dimension, it counts as a mirror duplicate. These dimensions are alternate realities, not planes, so even spells like Interplanar Teleport can't reach them.

distortion-mirror.descripcion: Fun-house mirrors distort a viewer's reflection, painfully reshaping their body to match what appears in the reflected images.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 38 (master) to deface the mirror's pane, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 36) to dispel the mirror or counteract the transformation
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 day.

earthquake-13-14.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-19: What Walks Again
earthquake-13-14.descripcion: The earth shakes violently side to side, opening a fissure in the ground, partially collapsing builds, and scattering debris in all directions.

endless-realities.fuente: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
endless-realities.descripcion: A mass of illusions floods the senses of creatures, plunging them into an ever-shifting maze of fluid realties.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 38 (legendary) to seize strands of a false reality and tug at them to unravel the surrounding illusions, Arcana DC 41 to take command of the illusions in a false reality and force them to consume themselves, Dispel Magic (7th-rank; counteract DC 39) to counteract one of the four realities the illusion creates
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The trap shifts from the current reality into a randomly determined one that affects all those lost within the illusion in a different way. The new reality restores 20 healing Hit Points to itself if it had previously taken damage. Each time a PC succeeds at a check or Dispel Magic attempt to disable the trap or the current reality is reduced to 0 HP, the current illusory reality vanishes, leaving the PCs in an infinite haze of nothingness save for a three-tailed comet burning in the "sky" above (recognizable as the Trinity Star with a Arcana DC 25, Nature DC 25, Occultism DC 25, or Religion DC 25 check) until the trap takes its next action and randomly determines its new reality from the options that remain. If only one endless reality remains when it's disabled or destroyed, the PCs are returned to the real world and the trap is entirely disabled.
When the endless reality shifts, determine its effects and appearance by randomly selecting from the following (rerolling any results that have already been disabled or destroyed).
Each time a PC critically succeeds at a saving throw to resist a reality's damage, the trap degrades; it's disable DCs and hardness are reduced by 2 with each such critical success. If the trap's hardness is reduced to 0 in this way, the entire trap is disabled at once.
Burning Reality (fire) Additional Immunity fire; Effect The world appears to catch on fire, while legions of burning monsters attack the party. Every PC takes 10d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 34 save).
Frozen Reality (cold) Additional Immunity cold; Effect The world appears to crust over with ice, while armies of frozen ghosts assault the PCs. Every PC takes 10d6 cold damage (basic Reflex DC 34 save).
Impossible Reality (mental) Additional Immunity physical; Effect The world distorts into a reality of impossible geometry as the PCs feel their own bodies distort to match twisted reflections of unworkable configurations. Every PC takes 10d6 mental damage (basic Will DC 34 save).
Melting Reality (acid) Additional Immunity acid; Effect The world appears to dissolve away, as slithering oozes swarm out of the surroundings to engulf the PCs. Every PC takes 10d6 acid damage (basic Fortitude DC 34 save).

fungal-heart.descripcion: A pulsing green cluster of fungus suspended in the middle of the spherical room by thick lengths of fibrous stalks.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 33 (master) three times to carefully prune away specific tethers that keep the fungal heart active, or Religion DC 33 (master) three times to exorcise the demonic energies from the fungal heart.
datos.rutina: (1 action; divine, poison) The fungal heart clenches as if beating like a real heart, then exudes a churning cloud of toxic spores that fills areas D1 and D2. All creatures in these areas take 10d6 poison damage (basic Fortitude DC 34 save; creatures in area D1 gain a +4 circumstance bonus to this save due to the diffusion of the spores as they wash into the larger area).
datos.reinicio: The fungal heart deactivates and resets if 3 rounds pass during which no attempts to disable or damage it take place. On subsequent activations of "Treerazer Notices," no telepathic message is sent—it's simply an overwhelming sensation of imminent doom.

glyph-of-warding-d5.descripcion: A magical glyph flashes before triggering a spell.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (trained) to disable the glyph, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 34) to counteract the glyph

harmonic-barrier.descripcion: Every potential point of entry to the house, whether window or door, is covered with a barrier of sonic energy that prevents passage, visible as a faintly shimmering energy field.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 38 (expert) to remove the barrier from a single window or exterior door, Occultism DC 38 (master) to manipulate the harmonics in a way that disrupts the entire barrier (four successes are required to disable it), or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to counteract the barrier from a single window or exterior door
datos.reinicio: The harmonic barrier resets the instant after it's triggered.

haunted-forge.fuente: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
haunted-forge.descripcion: The rundown furnaces blaze to life, filling with metal and fire, while the wall of hardened lava to the east appears to revert to red hot molten rock.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 38 (master) to exorcise the spirits or Intimidation DC 41 to quell them with furious anger; three total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) The burning spirits shriek and howl, swooping in and out of the forges to the south, which roar into scorching life. The spirits scoop up gobs of phantasmal molten dawnsilver and hurl them at different targets in the room. Up to four randomly determined creatures are targeted in this way with molten dawnsilver Strikes (the spirits can target any creature in area B5). A single creature may be targeted only once per round, so if there are fewer than four different targets, the haunt's extra actions are lost. The haunt also loses two actions from its routine if one of the two forges are destroyed.
On a critical hit from a molten dawnsilver Strike, the target is Slowed 1 for 1 round as the molten dawnsilver swiftly cools and encases the target. Molten dawnsilver produced by the haunt vanishes entirely 1 round after it's been thrown.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour.

night-s-breath-trap.descripcion: The night giant mummy unfolds its arms and leans forward to exhale a blast of gray mist and shrieking spirits into the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 to "blind" the statue so that it cannot notice any who approach, Occultism DC 35 to redirect and expend the trap's occult energies harmlessly, or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 32) to counteract the trap.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets during the following round, after which it can be triggered again.

paradox-engine.descripcion: All six sides of this adamantine-reinforced box are covered with Thassilonian runes. Touching a rune allows one to exchange its position with another.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 41 (expert) to feel the subtle vibrations when moving a rune to shift into the right position, or Thassilon-lore DC 33 (expert) or Society DC 38 (master) while being able to read Thassilonian to work out the anagram puzzle using traditional means, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 34)
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The slicing shadows congeal into the form of what appears to be the upper half of a skeletal, cowled humanoid: an Owb Prophet. This owb prophet is a creation of the paradox engine and does not have a forsaken patron. While the owb prophet is active, the paradox engine no longer uses its Slicing Shadows reaction; instead, the owb prophet focuses its attacks on creatures that attempt to damage or deactivate the engine. If the owb prophet is destroyed, the paradox engine's disable DCs and Hardness are reduced by 5. It thereafter functions as a simple hazard with the Slicing Shadows reaction, and resets after 1 round.
datos.reinicio: The paradox engine deactivates 1 minute, and its owb prophet returns to its interior after all creatures leave the area, but resets immediately thereafter.

poisoned-dart-statue.fuente: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven
poisoned-dart-statue.descripcion: Countless poison darts fire from holes in the statues and walls of this hall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (master) on the control panel deactivates the trap.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap launches one dart against every creature in the hall as 1 action. Because it launches darts continuously, the trap can also use the Continuous Barrage free action (see below) to launch darts at each creature during that creature's turn. The trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

poisoned-secret-door-trap.descripcion: Multiple tiny needles filled with poison are embedded in this secret door, spring-loaded to pop out.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (expert) to break the mechanism, or Perception DC 39 (master) to identify the three stones that, when pressed, prevent the trap from triggering
datos.reinicio: If disabled, the trap resets after 1 minute.

quaking-footfall.descripcion: Mogaru's steady footsteps pick up speed, causing the earth around him to tremble as though from a powerful earthquake.

datos.desactivar: Three Athletics DC 39 (trained), Crafting DC 39 (trained), or Engineering-lore DC 39 (trained) checks to brace a small structure or surface to cancel the effects of the quake in that area; Performance DC 41 (legendary) to calm Mogaru momentarily
datos.reinicio: Mogaru doesn't rush this way again for {1d4 rounds}.

quaking-slither.fuente: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth
quaking-slither.descripcion: Ebeshra slithers across the ground, causing the earth to tremble as though from a powerful earthquake.

datos.desactivar: three Athletics DC 38 (trained), Crafting DC 38 (trained), or Engineering Lore (trained) checks to brace a small structure or surface to cancel the effects of the quake in that area, or a single Diplomacy DC 41 (master) check to entreat Ebeshra to stand down
datos.reinicio: Ebeshra doesn't rush this way again for  rounds.

sand-whirlwind.descripcion: Buffeting winds swirl sharp grains of sand about the room.

datos.desactivar: Religion (expert) to state an Iroran koan about being complete only upon recognizing one's incompleteness, or Occultism DC 41 (master) to create a ward against future hauntings
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt's violent winds savagely buffet everyone in the room, dealing 6d10+30 bludgeoning damage to living creatures (basic Reflex DC 34). On a critically failed save, a creature is also Blinded for 1 minute.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates after 1 minute and re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt is disabled and doesn't re-form if at least two creatures spend 1 minute to create an image with the sand. Creating the image requires a successful Crafting DC 30 or Thievery DC 30 check.

supplicant-statues.fuente: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven
supplicant-statues.descripcion: Six statues rapidly slide around the room on rollers, slowing down intruders and striking at them with spring-loaded sword arms.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 34 (master) to disable a specific statue's rollers, or Thievery DC 39 (master) on the control panel in A4 deactivates the whole trap. For each statue disabled, the trap loses 1 action from its routine and the DC for its predictive impediment ability decreases by 4. Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 32) doesn't harm the statues but removes the predictive impediment ability. Breaking the control panel prevents the trap from resetting.
datos.rutina: (6 actions) On the trap's initiative, each functioning statue slides up to 40 feet around the room and makes a statue shortsword Strike against an adjacent creature. The trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty, and the statues' movements don't trigger reactions.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets one minute after the room is empty.

the-putrid-rise.descripcion: The stink of bile suddenly grows as the myriad mouths carved into the walls begin to vomit forth a deluge of acidic slurry.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) to disrupt the trap's magical network of sensors and effectively "blind" it to targets to react to, Religion DC 38 (master) to recognize the carvings and recall one of the mantras needed to pass safely, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 32) to counteract the trap.
datos.rutina: On its turn, the trap Vomits as its action. As long as the Putrid Rise is active, the stairs in area D3 are difficult terrain.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates 1 round after no targets can be sensed, but resets immediately.

thunderclap-rune.descripcion: An Invisible rune imprinted on the door latch releases a powerful sonic discharge that automatically alerts the guards in area D6 that intruders are nearby.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 38 (master) to scratch out the rune without allowing it to activate, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rune

trapped-arudora-soul.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
trapped-arudora-soul.descripcion: A ghostly image of one of the Arudoras floats in the middle of the room, arms folded over their chest as if reclining in a coffin, yet they hover vertically and are shrouded by ribbons of green smoke.

datos.desactivar:
Religion DC 41 to exorcise the haunt, or one of the following checks depending on the Arudora; four total successes are required to disable the haunt.
J3a (Jinnivere) Nature DC 38 to draw upon her love of horses
J3b (Dazerien) Intimidation DC 38 to frighten the cruel murderer
J3c (Ryhasphinea) Deception DC 38 to trick her into believing she's been forsaken by Urgathoa
J3d (Augsten) Diplomacy DC 38 to explain that abuse of the servants shows weakness of character
J3e (Alisendra) Performance DC 38 to give her one last entertainment
J3f (Raudltz) Society DC 38 to help him come to terms with the shame he feels for his infidelities
J3g (Irrokcis) Occultism DC 38 to use his own obscure theories against him to banish him
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the haunt transforms into a physical manifestation of that Arudora's personality and lashes out, dealing 9d6 untyped damage to all creatures in the room and within 30 feet of any open doorway outside the room. A PC can attempt a DC 34 basic saving throw against the damage. The type of damage and saving throw to defend against it depend on the Arudora, as does the additional condition imparted on a critical failure. Conditions imparted by this haunt are curses that have unlimited durations.
J3a (Jinnivere) trampling horses (bludgeoning damage, Reflex save, Clumsy 1 on a critical failure)
J3b (Dazerien) complex torture devices (piercing damage, Reflex save, Enfeebled 1 on a critical failure)
J3c (Ryhasphinea) skull-faced spirits (spirit damage, Will save, Stupefied 1 on a critical failure)
J3d (Augsten) barbed whip and scourge Strikes (slashing damage, Reflex save, Enfeebled 1 on a critical failure)
J3e (Alisendra) shrieking spirits and discordant instruments (sonic damage, Fortitude save, stupefied 1 on a critical failure)
J3f (Raudltz) ghostly fangs that chew into your thoughts (mental damage, Will save, Drained 1 on a critical failure)
J3g (Irrokcis) decaying skeletal limbs (void damage, Fortitude save, drained 1 on a critical failure)
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates as soon as no living creatures are in the room, then immediately resets.

void-garden.descripcion: Six eerie purple crystals react to the presence of life, pulsing with flashes of violet light that seem to match the heartbeats of living creatures in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) or Nature DC 35 (master) to discern a hairline fracture that, when struck, shatters a crystal to dust
datos.rutina: (6 actions) The void garden's crystals each use an action to fire a void ray, a beam of destructive dark purple energy, at a random living creature in the room or in visible reach through the open doorway (the crystals don't fire at living targets on the balcony in area D6c). A single creature can be targeted only once per round by a void ray. The void garden loses one action for each crystal that is disarmed or destroyed.
datos.reinicio: The void garden deactivates 1 round after all living targets leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

a-falling-star-s-memories.fuente: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
a-falling-star-s-memories.descripcion: The shaft walls vanish and are replaced by an endless field of stars in all direction, as if the viewer were suddenly lost in outer space.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 40 (master) to unweave the magic left in the wake of the Trinity Star's passage, Thievery DC 43 (expert) to etch temporary runes to siphon away the magic, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 33) to counteract the magic; three successes are required to disable the trap. Once the PCs are within the trap's overwhelming illusion, they can still attempt these checks to disable it, but the check DCs increase by 2.
datos.rutina:
A Voyage Through the Infinite (1 action) Every round on its turn, the trap inflicts all creatures in the shaft with the perception that they have been hurtling at an unimaginable speed through the vastness of space. The stars are so distant that no indication of movement can be observed or felt beyond that overwhelming mental conviction. At the same time, the creatures feel as if something unimaginably powerful and hungry is chasing them... and gaining on them. Any PC who looks over their shoulder sees that the stars are indeed winking out behind them, as if an immense black object were growing closer or as if the stars themselves were vanishing. While the PC's body is somehow protected by the vastness of space, their minds are not—each PC must attempt a Will DC 40 save.

—
Critical Success As success below, but the creature also realizes they're reliving the memories of Runelord Xanderghul—like him, they're escaping some sort of horrific fate and are hurtling toward Golarion. The next time this creature achieves a critical success against this trap, they suddenly see Golarion loom large, and as they witness their "crash" into the Throne of the Troll King, they suddenly wake, Prone, in area C1 at the heart Xin-Cyrusian. If any other PCs are still trapped in the Falling Star's Memories, a PC in Xin-Cyrusian knows instinctively that they can call out to those trapped PCs—each PC in Xin-Cyrusian who does so reduces the save DC against A Voyage Through the Infinite for those still trapped by 5.
Success The creature realizes they're experiencing the path the Trinity Star took through the cosmos and becomes Frightened 1.
Failure The creature's grip on reality fades as they experience what seems like years or even decades of hurtling adrift through a vast expanse. The creature becomes Stupefied 1 for 24 hours or increases the value of their stupefied condition by 1 if they're already stupefied.
Critical Failure As failure, but Stupefied 2 (or increase the stupefied condition by 2).

—
Special If this trap would cause a creature's stupefied condition to exceed Stupefied 5, the creature instead "crashes" to the ground on the hilltop outside, about ten feet from the Throne of the Troll King. The creature takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 40 save), and their stupefied condition now has an unlimited duration.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically.

auto-turret.fuente: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star
auto-turret.descripcion: A mounted gun equipped with a magical targeting system and integrated ammo supply.

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 35 (master) to disconnect the turret from its ammo supply system, or Arcana DC 35 (master) to neutralize the magical targeting system.
