choking-tethers.descripcion: Three shadow tethers form when a creature reaches the hall's midpoint; each lashes, grabs, and crushes creatures in the hall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to disable each tether or Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 48) to counteract each tether
datos.rutina: (six actions) This trap loses 2 actions each turn for each disabled shadow tether. Each shadow tether has 2 actions it can use to either Strike a creature or Constrict a Grabbed creature, in any combination.

collapsing-floor.descripcion: The westernmost 5 feet of the building gives way, dropping rubble and anyone in the area into the depths of the Lantern Kingdom below.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 51 to quickly jury-rig key supports against weak wall sections to prevent the collapse

colossus-rampage.descripcion:
Monsters of titanic proportions awaken and stampede across the land, crushing everything in their wake. These might be a group of battling kaiju, an army of titanic constructs, or another onslaught of oversized creatures. This hazard works best when combined with combat against one or more massive monsters. These creatures might notice the PCs' strength and decide to get rid of them before the PCs have a chance to interfere with their onslaught.
Anticipate DC 32 (master) skill check with a skill typically used to Recall Knowledge about the rampaging creatures to notice subtle signs of their proximity in the surrounding landscape (DC 30 if it's a Lore skill) or Survival DC 38 (master) to notice the ground trembling from immense footfalls

Prepare Crafting DC 48 (master) or Thievery (master) to lay traps to hamper the approaching rampage; DC 50 (master) skill check with a skill typically used to Recall Knowledge about the creature's type to make targeted preparations (DC 46 if it's a Lore skill); or Warfare-lore DC 46 (master), Intimidation DC 48 (master), or Diplomacy DC 50 (master) to rally nearby troops to prepare for battle

datos.rutina:
(10+ minutes, Flat DC 15) The colossus rampage affects the entire area, but whether or not the affected area remains static, moves, expands, or otherwise changes is left to you to determine as the story needs. At the start of each minute, unprepared creatures in the area take 3d10+10 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 47 save). A creature that fails the save is jostled enough that they're Off-Guard for that minute, while a creature that critically fails is pinned under fallen debris and becomes Immobilized until they .
Two additional effects, based on the nature of the creatures and the battlefield, take place during that minute. Roll  for each to determine on which round during that minute each effect takes place (rerolling duplicate rounds). You can create alternative abilities to better fit the nature of the creatures in the stampede, but in general, consider selecting one ability that imposes a condition or battlefield effect and one that deals damage. Note that these effects can affect prepared and unprepared creatures in the area, but when a prepared creature attempts a save against any of these effects, they increase their result by one degree of success.

compression-tunnel.descripcion: This shadow tunnel compresses when creatures pass through.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 46 (legendary) twice to push back the shadows or Thievery DC 48 (legendary) three times to pierce through the shadows
datos.rutina: (1 action) The tunnel compresses, crushing all creatures in it and dealing 4d10+22 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude DC 42). On a failed save, a creature additionally becomes Immobilized ().

convergence-lattice.descripcion: A complex clockwork of bright metal and delicately carved gemstones, the lattice's interlocking gears begin to whir as golden runes glow across its surface.

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 40 (master) or Religion DC 35 (master) four times to obliterate each of the four key runes.

A Thievery DC 45 (legendary) check (or breaking the lattice) stops the clockwork's movement and prevents it from resetting, but doesn't stop its current activation.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) The convergence lattice uses its first action to call for aid. Each convergent creature within 100 feet of the lattice Strides toward the lattice as a reaction. Creatures thus called continue to move toward the lattice on their turn each round until they are adjacent to it, at which point they defend it with their lives.

The lattice uses its second action to deal 16d6 mental damage (basic Will DC 42 save) to a non-convergent creature within 100 feet. This damage is nonlethal; a creature knocked out by this damage doesn't gain the dying condition and is automatically Controlled by the convergence lattice when they awaken.

The lattice uses its third action to make the same attack against a second non-convergent creature within 100 feet; if there isn't such a second creature, it doesn't take its third action.
datos.reinicio: The convergence lattice deactivates and resets after there are no uncontrolled targets within line of sight for 1 minute.

crush-the-uninvited.descripcion: A warning carved into the door frame magically crushes any who pass through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to scratch out the warning or Dispel Magic (10th rank; counteract DC 48) to counteract the magic in the warning

crystal-pin.fuente: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth
crystal-pin.descripcion: Ebeshra fires a crystal at a creature to pin them onto the Material Plane.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 48 (legendary) or Religion DC 48 (legendary) to earn Ebeshra's favor and allow safe travel or Deception DC 51 (master) to momentarily divert Ebeshra's attention
datos.reinicio: Ebeshra waits  rounds to break off another crystal.

echoes-of-the-end.descripcion: An overwhelming trumpeting fills the area as the apocalypse seed vibrates and shakes off the encrusted bone that's accreted around it to reveal a large tooth fragment from some immense monster.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 50 (master), Occultism DC 50 (legendary), or Religion DC 50 (legendary) to recognize and shore up the area against the localized planar instability causing a connection between the apocalypse seed and Jandelay, or Athletics DC 53 (legendary) to grasp the apocalypse seed and muffle its vibrations with your embrace. Four successes are needed to muffle the aura enough against the planar instability and end the hazard.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude DC 44 save. A creature with the slowed condition from this hazard takes a –2 penalty to this save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 2d10+10 sonic damage.
Failure The creature takes 4d10+20 sonic damage and is Slowed 1 until the start of the hazard's next turn.
Critical Failure The creature takes 8d10+40 sonic damage and is Slowed 2 for 1 round.
datos.reinicio: The apocalypse seed creates another area of instability after 24 hours.

eldritch-echoes.descripcion: Those who listen to the sounds for too long become convinced that these forces can be defeated by lashing out at them, even though the forces themselves are not apparent.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 42 (master) to counter the eerie sounds by exceeding their influence with a virtuoso act, or Intimidation DC 48 (master) to startle the echoes into silence with a display of anger and rage.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; emotion, enchantment, mental, primal) The trap starts scrambling senses and forcing creatures to perceive threats to their very place in time and space where no such threats actually exist. Every creature in area K13 must attempt a Will DC 42 saving throw.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure As success, but the creature is also Confused as long as it remains stupefied.

Critical Failure The creature is Stupefied 2 and confused. The confused condition persists until the creature recovers normally, but the stupefaction effect is permanent until removed.

explosion-bear.descripcion: An invisible rune causes the animated bear to explode if it is destroyed or if it finishes its dance while anyone is in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to erase the rune without triggering the explosion (the DC is increased to Thievery DC 51 while the bear is moving), Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 39) to counteract the rune, or Nyrissa says the words "Good bear" to the trap before it finishes its dance.

fate-of-eivess.descripcion: The restless spirits of the prophet Eivess and his followers force intruders to relive their deaths at the fangs of Yig's avatar.

datos.desactivar: Society DC 38 (master) or Religion DC 40 (master) to convince the spirits that their horror has been over for millennia, or Occultism DC 38 (master) or Intimidation DC 42 to recognize that this avatar exists only in the memories of the tormented spirits and command it to stand down; three total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The avatar uses its first action each round to Devour Faithful, then attempts to Strike and swallow a frightened creature within 20 feet. If no nearby creatures are frightened, the avatar continues using its actions to Devour Faithful until a frightened victim becomes available.

field-of-opposition.fuente: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
field-of-opposition.descripcion: A distortion in space spawns an aggressive, malevolent shadow duplicate of any characters who pass between Terimor's faces.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 42 (legendary) to permanently disable the planar distortion (DC increases by 2 for each duplicate still extant), or Dispel Magic (10th rank; counteract DC 42) to destroy the planar distortion

force-and-flame.descripcion: Four invisible runes on a large crate conjure jets of flame and whips of force when someone tries to open the container.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 45 (master) to erase each rune, Arcana DC 48 (master) to channel energy from one rune into another, destroying both, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 45) to counteract each rune; a PC can choose to disable a fire rune or a force rune (or choose randomly)
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap has 1 fewer action for each rune that's been disabled or destroyed; whether that rune was a fire rune or a force rune affects the actions the trap can take. On the trap's initiative, the two fire runes each blast 30-foot cones of flame as an action in opposite directions that deal 12d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 44 save). Then the two force runes each make a force whip Strike as an action against different targets.
datos.reinicio: The runes deactivate after 1 minute, but if at least one rune remains, the trap reactivates 1 round after that.

freezing-alarm.fuente: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
freezing-alarm.descripcion: Miniature snowflake-shaped glyphs on the ground cause a layer of ice to ripple over the floor of the room and sound a silent alarm.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 53 (legendary) to draw a fiery counteracting glyph over each snowflake, or Dispel Magic (9th rank, counteract DC 48)
datos.reinicio: 1 day

fungal-curtain.fuente: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight
fungal-curtain.descripcion: A glowing wall of moss, lichens, mold, and stringy mushrooms weaves into a towering violet wall of shuddersome matter.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 42 (master) six times to identify and prune away the fungal curtain's six sensory bulbs (this doesn't remove the curtain; it must still be hacked through to allow access to the area beyond), or Religion DC 48 (legendary) twice to exorcise the fiendish energies that empower the fungal curtain and cause it to wilt into sludge
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The fungal curtain takes the following actions each round in this order; the fungal curtain can perceive targets via darkvision and has a Perception modifier of +38. On its first action, it extends a thorny tentacle to attempt a melee Strike on the closest target in reach—if there's no target in reach, the fungal curtain loses this action. On its second action, it fires a volley of thorny spores into area E5, attempting a ranged thorny spore Strike against all potential targets in the chamber. On its third action, it emits another whistling decay effect.
datos.reinicio: The fungal curtain deactivates at the end of any round where there were no foes in area E5, then resets at the start of the next round. It restores 10 Hit Points to each damaged section every hour.

glimpse-grave.descripcion: A tombstone bears the name of those who look upon it, causing their hearts to seize.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 45 (legendary) to bless the tombstone or Occultism DC 50 (trained) to ward off spirits
datos.reinicio: 1 day

inky-tendrils.fuente: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
inky-tendrils.descripcion: Six giant tentacles reach up from the ink lake, grabbing any foes in reach and dragging them underwater.

datos.desactivar:
Athletics DC 48 (legendary) or Acrobatics DC 45 (master) to tie one tentacle into a knot, rendering it useless, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 44) to counteract one tentacle.

The death of the Daemonic Rumormonger permanently dispels all the inky tendrils.
datos.rutina: (6 actions) The hazard loses 1 action for every tentacle that is disabled or destroyed. The tentacles can combine their actions to use the hazard's Inky Imitator ability. A broken tentacle can still Strike, but it can't Grab. This hazard takes no multiple attack penalty.

keystone-repulsion.descripcion: Four magic keystones repel creatures when one is damaged or tampered with.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to remove each keystone or Occultism DC 48 (legendary) to manipulate the magic to isolate each keystone
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each removed or isolated keystone. Each keystone spends 1 action to release a wave of force, dealing 4d10+22 force damage in a 15-foot cone (basic Reflex DC 42) and pushing each creature back 5 feet. On a failed save, the distance a creature is pushed increases to 10 feet.

lapidarium-defense-grid.descripcion: The crystal lattices on the walls activate in turn, each projecting a hard-light grid of uniform, 6-inch-wide cells. The glowing grids then briskly sweep across the chamber in sequence, dicing organic matter they touch into precise cubes.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 40 (master) or Arcana DC 37 (expert) to physically or magically sabotage one of the lattices. Deactivating or destroying all four lattices deactivates the hazard.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) On each of the hazard's actions, a grid sweeps across the lapidarium in the following repeating sequence: west, north, east, south. A lattice that has been deactivated continues to use one of the trap's actions when its turn in the sequence is reached, but it no longer generates a grid.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets immediately once no living creatures occupy the lapidarium.

lesser-dragonstorm.descripcion: A small-scale version of a dragonstorm-a churning vortex of wind infused with fire, acid, lightning, poison, and ice-fills Alseta's Ring.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 40 (legendary) to call out to a non-evil deity for direct intervention to disperse the lesser dragonstorm (prayers to Apsu allow characters who are masters in Religion to attempt the check as if they were legendary instead), Thievery DC 42 (legendary) to deactivate Vengegate while the manifestation is forcing it open, or a successful Dispel Magic (10th rank; DC 40) to counteract the lesser dragonstorm.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the lesser dragonstorm reaches out and blasts all creatures within Alseta's Ring. Affected creatures take 10d8 damage (basic Reflex DC 46), evenly split between acid, cold, fire, electricity, and poison. Creatures that fail their save are pulled 20 feet toward the center of Alseta's Ring (or are knocked Prone and pulled 30 feet on a critical failure). After 10 rounds, the lesser dragonstorm is destroyed, but a much greater dragonstorm manifests in the surrounding region-see The Dragonstorm.

mental-assault.descripcion: Magic sigils Hidden in the grain of the wooden door trigger a magic trap that damages the mind of anyone attempting to pick the door's lock.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to deface the symbols or Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 48) to counteract the trap.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically if triggered and doesn't reset if disabled.

meteor-shower-escalation.descripcion:
Impact from a sufficiently large asteroid would be powerful enough to wipe out a region or destroy a planet, but smaller-scale impact events, like from a meteor shower, present hazards that could be survived. This shower might arise naturally, or it might be the result of the PCs or other forces preventing a greater calamity by breaking a world-rending asteroid into smaller pieces.
Anticipate Astronomy-lore DC 41 (master) or Nature DC 45 (legendary) to notice signs of the approach of unusual celestial bodies
Prepare Astronomy-lore DC 40 (master) or Nature DC 50 (legendary) to predict the trajectory of the falling asteroids and determine safe zones, Athletics DC 45 (legendary) or Crafting DC 47 (master) to dig underground shelters, Diplomacy DC 45 (master) or Intimidation DC 47 (master) to coordinate an orderly evacuation

datos.rutina:
(1+ minutes, Flat DC 17) Small asteroids rain down across the sky, battering and incinerating those caught in their path before carving craters. Over the course of a minute, enough asteroids smash into the ground and explode to inflict 7d10 bludgeoning,14d6 fire damage to any unprepared characters in the area (basic Reflex DC 46 save). The 40-foot-radius craters left behind are greater difficult terrain.
The material raining down from outer space includes chunks of adamantine. Adamantine's ability to break through the Hardness of materials is particularly lethal at terminal velocity. The falling adamantine has Hardness 20, allowing the asteroid's bludgeoning damage to overcome the Hardness of all materials with less Hardness, including shelters that would otherwise provide cover. Cover that's destroyed by the bludgeoning damage provides no protection against the fire damage.

ontoran.descripcion: The vengeful spirit of the murdered human wizard Ontoran drains the life from living intruders and channels it into his collection of unfinished crystalline constructs.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 48 (legendary) or Religion DC 48 (legendary) to exorcise Ontoran's spirit or Deception DC 50 or Diplomacy DC 50 (master) to convince him that the party will grant him vengeance against Nuzial; three total successes are required to disable the haunt. The haunt can also be disabled if all 4 of its crystalline constructs are destroyed.
datos.rutina: (9 actions) The haunt uses its first action to howl in fury, dealing 8d6 void damage to living creatures within 30 feet (basic Fortitude DC 42 save) and healing the crystalline constructs for 10 HP for each creature that took void damage. Each construct then uses 2 of the haunt's remaining actions to Stride up to 25 feet or make one or more crystalline fist Strikes. Each construct has its own multiple attack penalty, and the haunt loses 2 actions for each destroyed construct.
datos.reinicio: If all living creatures in the laboratory are slain or the haunt is successfully exorcised, any remaining crystalline constructs deactivate and the wizard's spirit fades away. If Ontoran was not convinced that his murder would be avenged, any broken or destroyed constructs are reconstituted over the course of 1 hour, even if no raw materials remain, and the haunt resets. If Ontoran is assured that he will have his vengeance, or if the Tectonic Forge is removed from the laboratory while the haunt is inactive, it is permanently disabled.

pendulum-pit.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death
pendulum-pit.descripcion: Several swinging pendulums of force cleave through the room across the platforms, knocking people into the pit.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 48 (legendary), Thievery DC 44 (master), or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 44) on a platform to deactivate its pendulum blade; once all five platforms have been deactivated, the trap is disabled and the room rotates back into position along the exits. Thievery DC 48 (legendary) from any blocked exit to activate the rotating mechanism and rotate the room back into position before the trap has been disabled.
datos.rutina: (5 actions) For each active platform, the trap uses an action to create a pendulum of force to swing down along a straight line between the platform and one other creature in the room that isn't on the platform (if any). The trap makes a pendulum blade attack against any creature in that line. For each platform deactivated, reduce the number of actions the trap takes in its routine by 1.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour. If the Darkness throughout the room has been dispelled, the darkness in the room returns when the trap resets.

planar-tear.fuente: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth
planar-tear.descripcion: Ebeshra opens a massive rift in the Material Plane that pulls nearby creatures into another plane entirely. The rift is typically to a random plane in the multiverse, though Ebeshra can have the rift pull creatures into a plane of Ebeshra's choosing. Additionally, Ebeshra can choose any number of creatures to be immune to the effects of the planar rift, usually due to the kaiju recognizing the innocence of the creatures.

datos.desactivar: DC 47 Lore (master) related to the specific plane beyond the rift to disrupt the planar frequency and close the rift, Arcana DC 52 (legendary) or Occultism DC 52 (legendary) to undo the magical manifestation of the rift, Performance DC 55 (legendary) to play a tone that counteracts the rift's harmonic frequency, or Diplomacy DC 55 (legendary) or Religion DC 55 (legendary) to plead with Ebeshra to close the rift
datos.rutina:
The rift pulls creatures within 500 feet toward it. The rift can pull any creature, regardless of its size. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude DC 45 or Reflex DC 45 save (the creature's choice) to resist the effects of this pull or attempt to grab something to avoid getting pulled.

—

Critical Success The creature resists the pull and doesn't move toward the rift.

Success The creature is moved 25 feet toward the rift.

Failure The creature is moved 50 feet toward the rift.

Critical Failure The creature is moved 100 feet toward the rift. The harsh pull causes the creature to take 10d6 bludgeoning damage.

If a creature is directly beneath the rift when the rift pulls it, the creature instead attempts a Fortitude DC 50 or Reflex DC 50 save (the creature's choice) to avoid being pulled into the rift. On a failure, the creature is pulled up into the rift and thrown to a random point on the plane on the other side.
datos.reinicio: Ebeshra vanishes 1 minute after opening the rift, which closes the rift. Ebeshra must wait 1 week before it can open another planar rift.

prime-nucleate-ein.descripcion: Ein uses her ability to project constructs of hardlight to harry intruders, hoping to slay them before they can free Death.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 38, Nature DC 38, Occult DC 38, or Religion DC 38 once to break an adjacent beam's magical connection with Death, followed by a Athletics DC 40, Crafting DC 40, or Thievery DC 40 check to reposition an adjacent lens so that the beam it reflects strikes Ein. Once a beam strikes Ein's body, she loses one action, and the beam follows her wherever she moves. When four beams are focused on Ein, her light body overloads and is destroyed, ending her assault.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) If Ein doesn't begin her turn within range of at least one enemy, she uses her first action to Fly into range, her next two actions to use Shattering Shriek (if available), and any remaining actions to use Ein's Assault or Bonds of Light, prioritizing creatures attempting to tamper with the lenses.
datos.reinicio: If Ein destroys the intruders, she retrieves Death, places him in a hard-light cocoon at the center of the temple, and then proceeds to return any repositioned lenses to their original alignment, trapping him once more. She then returns to her gem form and resumes her orbit around the chamber.

shadow-lash.descripcion: Four pillars manifest shadow lashes that attack intruders.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 46 (legendary) to drain the magic from each shadow lash or Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to disable each shadow lash
datos.rutina: (8 actions) This trap loses 2 actions each turn for each disabled shadow lash. Each shadow lash has 2 actions it can use to perform the following actions.

spirit-window.descripcion: Spirits trapped inside a haunted window harm those who touch the window.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 48 (legendary) to free the spirits from the mirror, or Religion DC 48 (legendary) to banish the spirits
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 round.

the-laughing-fiend-s-greeting.fuente: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
the-laughing-fiend-s-greeting.descripcion: Subtle but deadly magical runes link this mural to Kharnas's master. Good- or neutral-aligned creatures who examine the mural witness the castle's drawbridge silently descend, revealing an endless darkness.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 44 (legendary) to obscure or mar the magical runes set into the mural, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the mural
datos.reinicio: 1 week

thief-s-trap.descripcion: Nearly imperceptible runes set off an explosion at the point a thief is most unable to receive aid.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 45 (master) or Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 50) to counteract the runes
datos.reinicio: The trap resets in 1 minute.

time-rift.descripcion: A time rift focused on the sundial causes time to pass erratically for all creatures in the area.

datos.desactivar: Three Thievery DC 48 (legendary) or Occultism DC 48 (master) checks to mend the time rift.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) On its initiative, the time rift alters each creature's timeline. Each creature in the area rolls a {1d4} to randomly determine the effect on them.

1 The creature becomes Slowed 1 for 1 round.

2 The creature is unaffected.

3 The creature is affected erratically by time; they're Concealed for 1 round.

4 The creature becomes Quickened 1 for 1 round.

unfulfilling-banquet.descripcion: This banquet table is covered with a wide range of delicious-looking snacks and a mix of chilled and piping hot beverages.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 48 to offer prayers to neutralize the sour reputation of the food and render it safe to eat
datos.reinicio: The unfulfilling banquet resets instantly.

unstable-fiendflame-cage.descripcion: The Fiendflame Cage is uncontrolled, releasing holy light and hellfire in the area.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 48, Nature DC 48, Occultism DC 48, or Religion DC 48 (master) four times on the Fiendflame Cage to calm it through ritual incantations
datos.rutina: (2 actions) On its initiative, the Fiendflame Cage uses 1 action to release a wave of hellfire, dealing 2d10+12 spirit damage and 2d10+12 fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot-radius burst (basic Reflex DC 47). The Fiendflame Cage uses its second action to release a wave of holy light, dealing 2d10+12 spirit damage and 2d10+12 fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot-radius burst (basic Reflex DC 47).
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

urgathoa-s-ire.descripcion: A statue of Urgathoa fires eye beams at intruders.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 48 (legendary) to disenchant each eye through prayer or Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to disable each eye
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap shoots a concentrated beam of fire at a random intruder. The trap makes an eye beam Strike. If one of Urgathoa's eyes has been disabled, this Strike deals half damage.

void-pit.descripcion: An ice-caked pit with no bottom looks out into the depths of space.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 48 (legendary) to deactivate the pit's magical link to outer space or Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 44)
datos.reinicio: The Void Pit resets instantly.

watcher-in-the-wastes.descripcion: A massive sculpture of a wolflike form as tall as a mountain guards passage to the Cold Wastes at the northern end of Leng and seems almost ready to come to life at the approach of any creatures.

datos.desactivar: Stealth DC 51 (master) to avoid the initial notice of the gigantic form, or Occultism DC 48 (legendary) to know the proper posture and hand sign to make to turn away the watcher's attention
datos.reinicio: The nightmare resets immediately.

animus-of-longing.descripcion: Three pitchers pour water in an endless cascade, each decorated with a symbol of fertility, fecundity, and desire. The pitchers never empty, and the fountain below never overflows; the entire thing flickers with eerie red energy.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 50 (legendary) or Society DC 50 (legendary) to decipher the symbols and runes scribed across on the runewell and pinpoint which runes can be used to deactivate it, Thievery DC 53 (legendary) to temporarily disrupt the anima focus's connection to the Eye of Desire or to destroy a phantom of desire; three total successes are required to disable the hazard (destroying a phantom of desire counts as a single success)
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its turn, the animus of longing sustains the three phantoms of desire. The three creatures each take their turn.
datos.reinicio: The animus of longing deactivates as soon as no foes remain in the atrium, then immediately resets.

caustic-shower.descripcion: Contact with the doors, pillars, or statue causes a shower of acid.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 48 (master) to ground the charged features or Thievery DC 50 (legendary) to disable the contact sensors

greater-planar-rift.fuente: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
greater-planar-rift.descripcion: A ragged planar rift drags things into its depths and hurls creatures through from its terminal end.

datos.desactivar: Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 46) to seal the rift

mogaru-s-breath.descripcion: Mogaru exhales a blast of intense flames to eradicate any meddlesome pests in the area.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 50 (legendary) or Deception DC 53 (legendary) to momentarily divert Mogaru's attention
datos.reinicio: Mogaru must wait {1d4 rounds} before letting loose another gout of fire.
